question: What is the aim of the FASTER initiative launched by the Supreme Court of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Faster court order transmission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **FASTER** initiative stands for **Fast and Secured Transmission of Electronic Records**. It was officially launched by the then **Chief Justice of India (CJI)**, **N.V. Ramana**, on **March 31, 2022**.
 
• The primary objective of the **FASTER** system is to ensure the **faster transmission** of court orders, specifically **interim orders**, **stay orders**, and **bail orders**, to the relevant authorities like **prison officials** and **lower courts**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Faster court order transmission.***
